meta.title: Student Guide & FAQ
meta.subtitle: A growing library of answers to commonly asked questions and general guidance for students — accessible and up-to-date to fill gaps when needed.
meta.contact: Still have questions? Contact your Student Ambassador via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official university rulebook?
faqs.answer:
Access the official university rulebook here. Chapter 1 outlines foundational definitions, while Chapter 2 details Bachelor's degree regulations.

Where necessary, frequently applicable guidelines are summarized within this catalog for convenient reference.

In the event of any discrepancies, the official university rulebook shall take precedence.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for transferring to another university?
faqs.answer:
To initiate a transfer to another institution, you must first contact the administration of the target university to discuss your specific case and verify their transfer eligibility criteria and required documentation.

Once the target university provides the required list of documents, please visit the Administrative Offices at CUST to request and collect the official records needed to complete your transfer process.

faqs.question: What are the standard university office timings?
faqs.answer: Main administrative offices operate from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

faqs.question: How do I register my vehicle for university parking?
faqs.answer:
To register your vehicle, complete the parking registration form available on the Student Affairs Facebook Page.

Following submission, present your registered vehicle along with your student ID at the Main Entry Gate to collect your parking sticker.

faqs.question: How do I enroll in courses for the upcoming semester?
faqs.answer:
Semester enrollment typically opens a few weeks prior to classes commencing. Exact dates are announced via the official WhatsApp community and the University Noticeboard.

To register, navigate to the course registration portal and select your desired classes. Please verify that all course prerequisites are met beforehand.

For assistance with registration errors, email aodoc@cust.edu.pk with:

  • Your full name and registration number
  • A detailed description of the issue
  • A relevant screenshot of the error, if applicable

faqs.question: What steps should I take if I accumulate three probations?
faqs.answer: Probation matters must be addressed directly with the Student Affairs Office prior to the closing of course enrollment for the upcoming semester.

faqs.question: What is the procedure to clear or remove a grade bracket?
faqs.answer: Please visit the Examination Office directly for guidance regarding clearing or removing brackets.

faqs.question: My student portal or Microsoft Teams account is blocked. How can I unblock it?
faqs.answer: For any portal or MS Teams access errors, email sysadmins@cust.edu.pk with your account details and an attached screenshot of the error message.

faqs.question: What should I do if my registered phone number is inaccessible and I cannot receive verification codes?
faqs.answer: Please reach out directly to the IT Department for assistance with updating or verifying your contact details.

faqs.question: How do I apply for kinship scholarships?
faqs.answer: Kinship scholarships are processed on a per-semester basis. To apply, visit the Registration Office after semester registration closes but before tuition fee payment is due.

faqs.question: How do I obtain my official transcript and degree certificate following graduation?
faqs.answer: Graduating students can request their official transcripts and degree certificates directly through the Examination Office.
